title: VP, Greater China Region (GCR)
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.    Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.   The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.    We are looking for a strong business leader to lead our fast-growing business in the Greater China region, who will be responsible for driving our business strategy and growth, without compromising on innovation or our Company culture. The person will also have the proven ability to inspire and empower their teams to stretch themselves to achieve ever greater goals and to collaborate closely both locally and globally. You will also mentor and lead our business teams to build consultative business relationships and ensure long-term client success.     
  The person is a strategic business leader – with a strong ability to envision, create and execute on highest impact growth opportunities, to shape and influence how the markets think about our industry and company and can foster the most senior, strategic relationships in the respective regions. This person will be motivated by a desire to make advertising work better for brands, publishers, and partners in those markets.     
  They must have a high aptitude for and comfort level with working in complex business and technology environments along with a strong leadership and business acumen.     
  This role can be based in Hong Kong     
   What You'll Do      
 
  Will be the external and internal figurehead for the TTD’s China, Taiwan and Hong Kong business     
  Lead team to develop and land strategic market plans to achieve revenue goals     
  Working with the team to define and lead an effective upstream sales strategy     
  Own and sponsor relationships with senior levels of stakeholders within target accounts and partners     
  Collaborate with other functional leaders to identify growth opportunities, solve business challenges and drive efficiency across the organization     
  Strong cultural leadership across the whole GCR business.  Driver in creating an environment that inspires the Sales organization to perform effectively and efficiently     
  Ensure effective team management through coaching, mentoring and development of the team     
  Contribute in product roadmap build-out discussions based on client needs with senior leadership, product, & engineering     
 
   Who You Are      
 
  15+ years of experience in online advertising. At least 10 years in a team leadership capacity     
  Deep understanding of the advertising landscape and agency ecosystem across GCR, including China export      
  Proven track record of working within GCR region and strong relationships in the regional markets     
  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to speak to C-Level clients and establish client relationships     
  Proven track record of driving and exceeding revenue expectations through a history of sales leadership experience     
  Strong management and leadership skills through a collaborative team approach     
  Proactive in managing and developing talent as well as talent attraction     
  Ability to navigate difficult and ambiguous situation

title: Senior Account Manager, Demand
description:
Liftoff   is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.  
  Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.     About this team:   
 As a Senior Account Manager on the APAC Demand Team, you’ll be responsible for managing some of the region's key customer relationships. You will deliver outstanding, industry-leading client service to mid to senior level POCs, ensuring client happiness as determined by peer & client feedback. You will be expected to demonstrate ownership of your book of business, understanding your clients business goals and requirements innately and navigate internally to deliver on these. 
 This is a position based in Beijing, reporting directly to the Senior Manager, Existing Business. 
  Responsibilities:  
 
 Manage a portfolio of mobile advertisers, launching their campaigns, defining their strategies, upselling, and aligning internal resources to execute their goals 
 Partner with cross-functional teams (Analytics, Creative, Product, and Operations) to deliver best-in-class support and campaign optimization, facilitating growth across internal and external objectives 
 Develop and execute strategic account plans that align the customer’s business objectives with the company’s product / service capabilities. 
 Demonstrate fluency in analyzing and leveraging complex datasets to drive account growth and performance improvements. 
 Forecast revenue and manage a healthy pipeline of both existing and prospective clients. 
 Build strong relationships with mid level POCs to senior director levels; Introductory relationships with higher level stakeholders 
 Strong level of understanding of adtech and digital performance ecosystem; consulting clients on the right strategy to meet their goals 
 
  Requirements:   
 
 Bachelor's or Master’s degree and 5-7+ years of work experience. Minimum 3-5 years of account management or enterprise sales experience - preferably in  ad tech, mobile marketing, fintech, gaming, or digital consulting.  
 Proven track record of managing a revenue quota and delivering against performance goals. 
 Organization and  project management skills, strong commercial sense and negotiation skills.  
 Creative solution-seeking skills 
 Lead cross-team collaboration and project management to meet clients’ requests and drive revenue impact. 
 Comprehensive understanding of the  mobile app   and/or digital media ecosystem  
  Strong analytical mindset —comfortable working with data, extracting insights, and building client-facing narratives. Experience with enterprise level tools such as Tableau, Looker, Salesforce are a plus. 
  Excellent communication and presentation skills  – able to craft and deliver compelling executive briefings and account reviews. 
 Excellent communicator who can present complex ideas clearly and persuasively. 
 Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and excited to work in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. 
 Willingness for quarterly business travel as required - both within APAC and internationally. 
 Business fluent in English and Mandarin Chinese.

 We prefer this role to work from our Beijing office (Guomao) at least 2-3 days/week. 
  Travel Expectations:  
 We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. You’ll be responsible for maximizing customer lifetime value and success for a diverse portfolio of thousands of expanding MongoDB customers, acting as a strategic connector between your customers and providing the right help at the right time to achieve their unique business goals. You’ll drive healthy adoption, customer retention, revenue realization, and advocacy at scale. You will innovate, navigate ambiguity, and build scalable programs and processes to deliver real, measurable impact where your customers need it most. 
 We are looking for Mandarin speaking candidates who are based in Hong Kong for our hybrid working model.

 Customer Advisory 
 
 Lead and scale effective customer onboarding by leveraging product adoption telemetry to monitor early deployment health, proactively identify and mitigate configuration risks, and guide customers through prescriptive best practices, architectures, and operational strategies that establish a strong technical foundation and accelerate time-to-value and achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 Drive ongoing consumption and value realization through a mix of 1:1 and 1:many engagements (e.g., targeted campaigns, webinars, office hours), using data-driven insights to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across a broad customer portfolio and recommending optimal solutions, features, and adoption paths to achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB

Proactively manage thousands of customers across various stages of maturity by leveraging 1-to-many methodologies and tools to balance individual customer impact with scalable outcomes that maximize long-term success 
 Track and report progress against key business outcomes, forecast revenue retention and realization to senior leadership for business predictability, and identify new opportunities to expand customer impact, collaborating with presales teams to support growth 
 Maintain meticulous hygiene in internal systems to ensure a single source of truth for customer insights and accurate territory analysis. Leverage AI-driven tools to streamline daily workflows, improve productivity, and optimize customer success outcomes 
 
 Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy 
 
 Amplify the voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging customer insights to inform MongoDB’s product roadmap and coordinate across Sales, Product, Services, Support, and Training teams to drive customer health, satisfaction, and value realization 
 Connect customers with the right internal resources, while contributing learnings from customer interactions to strengthen team success and maximize customer value. Contribute to the evolution of scalable programs that enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and measurable outcomes

Experience in managing scaled or pooled portfolios utilizing scalable strategies to enhance customer retention is a plus. Familiarity with designing workflows or engagement strategies using AI or automation-driven tools

 美团平台为用户的基础产品体验负责，还承担了美团的用户增长、市场和品牌营销以及多条业务线的产品设计职责，建立了融合文字、图片、视频和直播等不同形式的內容生态系统，同时整合地图服务部、客户服务和体验部、企业业务部、网约车业务部等部门，致力于用科技提升美团数亿消费者、近千万商家、骑手、司机和团长的服务体验。美团平台拥有高并发、多业务的复杂场景，为技术深度优化提供了最佳实践可能。这里有简单、讲逻辑、有爱的团队，更是一块理想的实战场地，舞台广阔，欢迎你来尽情施展。

岗位职责
1.提升美团企业消费解决方案在银行行业及国央企（三桶油，运营商，国家电网，建筑，港口，地铁，燃气，自来水等方向）的市场占有率，为业务获得线上交易GMV与服务费收入，完成团队及个人销售指标。
2.负责开发“企业差旅、用餐（工作餐，招待，团建及差旅补助等）、用车、员工福利”等方向的全国总分型大客户，主动开拓商机、制定销售策略、完成商机转化及客户签约，并配合解决方案及客户成功进行实施上线，获得线上交易GMV与服务费，达成业绩目标。
3.协助团队负责人及TL，探索行业解决方案及头部案例打造，重点探索国央企等潜在行业，为团队洞察潜在增长点。

岗位基本需求
1.大学本科及以上学历，5年及以上ToB销售经验，掌握大客户销售方法论，有较强的相关客户资源
2.具备较强的目标意识和学习能力，具备较强的客户自拓能力和生态经营意识，有不错的结构化思考与逻辑沟通能力、具备对解决方案理解和呈现能力。
3.思路清晰，能够准确把握客户痛点，产品优势和客户心理，制定合理的销售策略，高效整合内外部资源促进业绩达成。
4.有自驱力，积极主动，实事求是，正直诚信

具备以下者优先
1.有较强的客户资源及自拓能力者，有调研复盘意识的候选者。
2.有ToB顾问式销售和SaaS产品销售，以及费控平台，差旅平台、福利/工会平台销售背景者。
3.主导过国央企及政府机关、银行、证券、保险等大型SaaS项目销售和实施背景者优先
4.有一定的财务、人力、
行政、采购、工会等人脉关系者优先

岗位亮点
1.5万亿企业消费空间和潜在市场，当前线上化率约10%
2.美团企业版为企业提供一站式消费管理平台，覆盖企业用餐、差旅、用车、员工福利等场景，拥有较强的核心竞争力和业务价值，已服务数万家企业客户并积累最佳实践
3.业务处于上升期，可以给你充分的施展及上升空间；团队氛围求真务实，积极共享

title: 集团财务经理（费用方向）
company: 名创优品集团控股有限公司
description: 岗位职责： 1、制度流程建设：主导费用管理制度与流程的优化，制定并持续迭代 SOP 操作手册，推动集团及各子公司费用制度、流程的标准化与统一化。 2、核算系统建设：主导数字化、智能化费用核算系统的搭建，推动落地执行并持续迭代，提升费用核算的自动化与智能化水平。 3、会计核算：及时、准确完成各项费用支出审核、付款及月结、年结，配合内外部审计与函证等工作。 4、内控合规：建立并严格执行费用管控制度与多级复核机制，防范重复付款、错付、不合规票据等财务风险。 5、管理支撑：输出费用管理报表与数据分析，建立费用预警机制，支撑业务管理与经营决策。 6、跨部门协同：对接各业务部门，规范前端业务单据管理，推动费用管控要求在业务侧落地。 7、团队管理：统筹费用核算团队日常运作，合理分工，推进人才培养、绩效考评与团队建设。 任职要求： 1、本科及以上学历，财会相关专业；英语流利、可作为工作语言者优先； 2、6 年以上财务工作经验，其中 3 年以上费用核算/费用管理经验；有零售行业上市公司工作经验或四大背景优先； 3、熟悉 IFRS 及中国企业会计准则，精通费用核算全流程管理； 4、熟练使用 SAP 等主流ERP系统，熟悉发票系统、银企直联等核算工具。

title: 区域职能平台・环境经理（住宅业态）
company: 深圳市福睿金地智慧服务有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 一、岗位职责：
1、负责区域住宅业态环境条线年度 / 季度 / 月度工作计划制定，建立区域统一考核机制，监督、管控各项目计划落地执行，定期复盘指标达成情况。
2、负责区域住宅业态环境管理制度、作业 SOP、检查标准的修订、迭代与宣贯，包含保洁、绿化养护、四害消杀、景观水体、垃圾分拣、开荒、石材养护、高空作业等专项标准，结合业主诉求动态更新。
3、统筹住宅新项目前期介入、交房开荒、集中交付、筹备期环境技术支持，输出开荒方案、接管查验要点、交付环境保障方案，对集中交付环境风险、业主高频投诉问题专项帮扶。
4、统筹区域住宅环境品质管理，搭建区域巡检、飞检、交叉检查体系，督办环境类业主投诉、满意度短板、敏感点位（大堂、地库、泳池、儿童区、水景、绿化带）闭环整改，输出品质提升方案。
5、负责区域住宅环境条线人才梯队建设，搭建项目环境负责人、骨干培训体系，组织技能培训、案例复盘、跨项目交流，搭建后备人才库，输出带教与考核标准。
6、负责区域住宅环境重点专项、疑难问题、重大舆情、重大迎检（城管、环卫、文明城市检查等）的督导、方案输出与现场帮扶，牵头重大环境风险处置。
7、建立并监督住宅环境外包供方人员出勤、在岗、作业台账管理，定期开展人力数据分析、人效分析，识别缺编、怠工、人员流动性风险，推动供方优化人力配置。
8、牵头搭建、迭代住宅业态环境供方指导价体系、定价模型，区分常规养护、专项作业（开荒、修剪、消杀、石材翻新），支撑招标比价、成本测算，严控住宅环境成本。
9、审核区域住宅环境条线年度预算、专项预算，跟踪预算执行、耗材管控、费用偏差分析，推动降本增效，平衡品质与成本。
10、审核住宅环境供方月度履约评定报告，把控评定真实性、合规性；监督环境类招标立项、需求编制、评标、合同履约的合规性，规避招标风险。
11、落地住宅环境专项管理：垃圾分类、绿化季节性养护、景观水体运维、节假日园区氛围布置、汛期 / 台风环境应急方案，同步承接社区环境相关专项活动。
12、输出区域环境月报、季报、专项报告，对标行业标杆，持续输出住宅环境品质提升、供方优化、人效提升的落地举措。

二、任职要求
1、大专及以上学历，园林、环境工程、物业管理相关专业优先；
2、5 年及以上头部物业住宅环境管理经验，**至少 3 年片区 / 区域平台环境管理经验**，熟悉住宅园区绿化、保洁、消杀、开荒、垃圾分类全流程；
3、熟悉物业供方全生命周期管理、招标流程、预算编制、成本测算，有供方定价、评估、汰换实操经验；
4、熟悉住宅业主环境投诉特点、交付开荒、前期介入标准，具备较强现场问题诊断、疑难问题攻坚能力；
5、具备良好体系搭建、培训授课、跨项目协调能力，能独立输出 SOP、巡检方案、专项提升方案；
6、持有绿化、消杀相关证书优先；能接受区域内项目出差巡检。

title: React开发工程师（英文/金融）
company: 恩士迅信息科技（成都）有限公司
description: 岗位职责： 1，计算机科学或相关专业本科及以上学历优先考虑，具备扎实的计算机基础知识。 2，精通React框架及其生态系统，包括Redux、React Router等，能够熟练构建React应用。 3，熟悉TypeScript，具备良好的面向对象编程思想和编程习惯。 4，熟练掌握Webpack等模块打包工具，了解前端工程化、构建优化等相关知识。 5，3年以上的前端开发经验，有大型互联网项目或复杂应用开发经验者优先。英文可以基本交流（面试的时候做自我介绍和项目介绍和基本技术问答） 6，具备良好的代码风格和编程习惯，能够编写清晰、可维护的代码。 7，具备良好的英语沟通能力和团队合作精神，能够积极主动地与团队成员协作。 8，有AI相关项目经验或者相关管理经验优先考虑 薪资福利： 五险一金，0-1个月年终，双休，外企加班少 下午茶，生日会，节日活动，团建，节日礼品等等

title: AI大模型讲师
company: 哈尔滨鼎玉盛途网络科技有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 岗位职责：
1. 负责AI大模型方向课程的班级授课，覆盖Prompt工程、RAG 知识库、Agent/智能体开发、模型微调与部署、AI算法等模块
2. 根据企业真实用人需求，设计并带练大模型应用实战项目，指导学员完成从需求分析到项目落地全流程；
3. 参与课程体系设计与迭代：编写教案、课件、录制教学视频等配套资料，持续跟踪主流大模型与Agent并快速转化为新课程；
4. 完成学员答疑、阶段测评、学习效果跟踪等教学工作，保证学员学习质量；
5. 配合就业环节：梳理大模型方向高频面试题、组织模拟面试，为学员就业保驾护航。

任职要求
1. 学历专业：计算机科学、人工智能、软件工程等相关专业，本科及以上学历；
2. 工作经验：1-3年以上大模型开发、NLP或AI相关实战经验；
3. 基础能力：精通Python，具备扎实的算法与数据结构基础，熟悉Linux环境与Git，熟练使用至少一种深度学习框架(PyTorch/TensorFlow);
4. 理论功底：深入理解大语言模型原理，熟悉Transformer、Attention等核心架构，了解GPT、Qwen、GLM、DeepSeek、Llama等主流大模型;
5. 应用能力：具备Prompt工程、RAG、LangGraph、Agent等方向的实战经验，熟悉LangChain、Llamalndex、AutoGen等应用框架，能独立完成从需求分析到功能上线的全流程；
6. 加分项：有模型微调(SFT/LoRA)或部署经验(OIlama、vLLM、量化部署)，有云端部署经验(AWS/阿里云）者优先；
7. 教学素质：表达能力强、热爱教学、乐于分享；有培训经验者优先
8. 项目经验：有完整的AI大模型应用项目落地经验。有丰富的项目开发经验(可以是其他开发语言)，熟悉项目开发流程。

薪酬福利
1、办公环境舒适整洁，团队氛围融洽，领导亲和友善；享有加班补贴、下午茶、节假日福利等。
2、缴纳五险一金，国家法定节假日，享有带薪年假、婚假、丧假、病假等各类带薪休假。
公司目前拥有五大校区，经济实力雄厚、师资力量强大，现正火热扩招中，诚邀优秀人才加入，与我们共同成长！
上班时间：9:00-18:00 （午休2小时，大 小 周）

title: 管培生
company: 爱笔利（深圳）信息科技有限责任公司
description: 岗位职责： 1.参与公司轮岗学习，了解AI短视频、AI应用等业务和产品； 2.参与实际项目，承担研发、产品、销售、运营、交付等具体任务； 3.使用AI工具提升工作效率，参与内容生产、数据分析、客户支持等工作； 4.配合团队完成项目目标，做过程记录、数据复盘和汇报； 5.轮岗结束后，根据能力和业务需要定岗，独立承担岗位职责。 任职要求： 本科及以上学历，理工科优先：计算机、软件工程、人工智能、数据科学、自动化、电子信息、数学、统计等相关专业；特别优秀可放宽专业； 应届生或毕业1-2年内，对AI行业有真实兴趣； 学习能力强，逻辑清晰，沟通表达好； 有项目、竞赛、GitHub、实习、创业、社团组织等经历加分； 用过LLM API、AI视频工具、低代码/自动化工具、数据分析工具优先； 接受轮岗和定岗调配，愿意从具体项目做起，结果导向。 加分项：会python，c/c++

title: 边缘部署实习生
company: 广东一湾生命科技有限公司
description: 岗位职责 1、负责或参与目标检测、目标跟踪、姿态估计、行为识别等算法模型在边缘计算设备上的量化、部署与端侧推理加速 2、根据不同硬件平台特性，完成模型转换、推理框架适配和部署方案设计，例如 NVIDIA Jetson、昇腾、瑞芯微等 3、根据项目需求进行技术方案设计，并推进算法模块在实际产品中的集成与应用 4、协同软件、硬件和测试团队进行联调测试，优化模型推理速度、稳定性和资源占用 5、提供技术支持，解决模型部署、推理性能、兼容性和稳定性等问题 6、参与跨部门协作，确保项目目标顺利达成 岗位要求： 1、计算机科学、人工智能、电子信息、自动化、数学或相关领域的本科及以上学历，硕士优先 2、具备一年以上深度学习模型部署、边缘计算、模型推理优化或相关开发经验，优秀应届生有相关实习或项目经验也可 3、具备较强的编程能力，能够熟练使用 Python，掌握 C++/C 等工程开发语言 4、熟悉 PyTorch 等模型训练流程 5、熟悉模型导出、量化、推理验证和设备端部署的基本流程 6、熟悉至少一种主流推理部署框架或工具链，例如 TensorRT、ONNX Runtime、OpenVINO、RKNN、Ascend CANN 等 7、了解边缘计算设备的性能特点，能够针对 CPU、GPU、NPU 等不同硬件进行模型部署和性能调优 8、具备良好的问题分析能力、工程落地能力、团队协作精神和沟通能力 加分项： - 强烈的责任心、自我驱动能力、良好的学习能力； - 在CV、大模型、物理仿真等方面有实际项目经验者优先； - 在高水平国际会议和学术期刊发表过相关论文，或有高水平竞赛获奖经历者优先。 其他相关： 1、工作时间：周一至周五9:30 - 11:30，13:30 - 18:30，周末双休； 2、薪资待遇：3.5 - 4k/月，具体根据实际情况（如学历、相关经历、工作背景等）确认； 3、工作地点：广州市国际生物岛标准产业园四期； 截止日期：2027年10月28日 招聘人数：1人

title: 组织与人才发展经理
company: 广州立白科技集团有限公司
description: 工作职责： 1、运用专业工具（如组织健康度调研、六盒模型、7S模型等）进行组织诊断，识别在架构、流程、人才、文化等方面的优势与改进机会； 2、主导组织结构设计、优化和变革项目，确保组织架构与业务战略相匹配，提升协同效率； 3、主导或支持部门级战略变革项目（如业务转型），制定变革管理策略，评估变革风险，确保变革平稳落地； 4、推动及完善人才发展体系。包括推动人才盘点开展，发展计划制定，赋能各业务单元人才管理；协助完善部门人才规划、任职资格、人才盘点、晋升及发展体系，打造业务发展人才梯队； 5、负责公司培训和发展项目，设计针对关键岗位和培养继任者项目计划，提升员工技能和团队整体效能。 任职资格： 1、本科及以上学历，人力资源管理、组织心理学、企业管理、社会学等相关专业优先； 2、至少5年以上人力资源相关经验，其中至少3年以上专注组织发展（OD）及人才发展（TD）领域，有从0到1搭建体系或主导复杂OD项目、建立人才发展体系的成功经验； 3、出色的系统思考、战略洞察和问题解决能力，能够从复杂现象中抓住本质； 4、卓越的沟通、协调和影响力，能够与高层管理者平等对话，提供专业建议并推动共识； 5、强大的数据分析能力，能熟练运用数据进行诊断和决策。

title: 物业项目管理方向管培生
description:

5. 具备品牌与市场思维，理解产品系列化开发、视觉统一性及商品销售逻辑，能够兼顾品牌调性、设计创新与市场需求。

title: Senior New Business Manager
description:
About Moloco:  
 Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet. 
 Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system.   Moloco Ads   is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet.   Moloco Commerce Media   is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by  CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture) , the AI system behind every Moloco product. 
 At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer.  Come build what's next.     The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco  
 As a  Senior New Business Manager  for  Greater China , you will own the end‑to‑end acquisition and closing of strategic new logos across mobile apps, gaming, commerce, and streaming in the region. You will develop and execute account‑ and vertical‑level strategies, navigate multi‑stakeholder sales cycles, and shape how prospects in Greater China understand Moloco’s role in their growth. You’ll partner closely with New Business leadership, Growth, Implementation, Product, Data Science, and Marketing to identify the right prospects, craft compelling value propositions, and close complex deals that set customers up for long‑term success.

 Maintain a disciplined, accurate pipeline and forecast in CRM, providing clear visibility into deal stages, risks, and upside for the Greater China business. 
 
  Commercial Excellence & Deal Making  
 
 Identify and qualify performance‑driven upsell and expansion opportunities within your book of business in Greater China, designing proposals that balance client outcomes and Moloco revenue. 
 Lead complex deal structuring and negotiations (pricing, terms, tests, incentives) to overcome objections and close high‑value opportunities, leveraging data, benchmarks, and clear trade‑off narratives. 
 Use data‑driven storytelling to articulate business cases, quantify impact, and influence senior client stakeholders to take action (e.g., budget shifts, new product adoption, geo expansion). 
 Partner with Implementation and Growth to ensure clean handoffs and successful ramp‑up for new wins, aligning expectations on KPIs, timelines, and success criteria for the first 90 days and beyond. 
 
  Product Leadership & Solution Design  
 
 Develop a sophisticated understanding of Moloco’s products and the programmatic ecosystem in Greater China, including how our DSP and commerce/streaming solutions fit into a prospect’s broader tech and media stack.

5、文档与规范沉淀：输出标定方案、测试报告、接口协议、失效案例库与设计/可靠性规范，跨部门配合完成量产导入的技术问题解决。

 3+ years of experience leading complex projects and other analysts.

title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, Data Engineering
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    About the role  
  Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
 Netskope's Data Platform is the backbone behind every security insight our customers see, ingesting and processing security telemetry from a global edge network at massive scale. We own the full data path — from collection at the edge, through stream processing and enrichment, to the query, routing, and delivery systems that put that data in customers' hands. On top of that foundation we build the analytics, reporting, and export capabilities that our customers rely on to understand and act on their security posture. We are now investing in an AI-native future, building a semantic layer that makes our data machine-interpretable and agentic experiences that let customers ask questions of their data in natural language.

 Lead cross-team initiatives, shaping architecture through design reviews, and mentoring engineers, with the freedom to adopt modern & open source technologies.

 Experience designing for reliability at scale — observability, SLOs, incident response, and safe deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes).

We also work with external vendors on part selection and initial hardware bring-up.

 Bring up new devices and lead debugging and performance tuning exercises that span multiple hardware/firmware/software teams.

 Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation

  Who you are  
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
  Minimum requirements  
 
 2+ years software engineering experience in device driver development, embedded systems, or operating systems 
 2+ years working with mobile or other connected devices 
 Experience using automated testing, build systems, and inter-component communication protocols such as UART, GPIO, SPI, I2C, etc. 
 Proficiency in C/C++ or Kotlin/Java 
 Experience with Android OS, and familiarity with associated software development tools 
 Degree in CS, CE, EE, or equivalent practical experience 
 Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues 
 Fluency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese to be able to communicate with our vendors and users/customers 
 
  Preferred qualifications  
 
 Experience with ARM platform 
 Experience working with microcontrollers 
 Knowledge of EMV. 
 Knowledge of cryptography, symmetric, asymmetric, key management and exchange is an asset. 
 Experience with POS Hardware and peripherals. 
 Knowledge and expertise of PCI technology, transaction processing, and related retail standards.

description:

We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies and mathematical models. 
 Our Founding Partners, including Akuna's CEO Andrew Killion, first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Shanghai, Sydney, Singapore and London.

Our Shanghai office works with the latest hardware and software technologies to develop high performance low latency solutions that are robust and scalable, ensuring our strategies are as fast as possible for Akuna’s global trading operations. We run happy hours, have a fully stacked snack room with free drinks and fresh fruits, host team events, social club events, and offer great training with our Akuna University.  We're looking for a Junior Quantitative Researcher who will work specifically on deep learning projects involving large-scale time series data. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on DL experience over general ML/data science backgrounds. In this role you will: 
 
 Develop trading strategies using statistical and deep learning technologies 
 Design and implement optimization algorithms for portfolio construction 
 Develop quantitative models describing market behavior

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.     Your Location:  
  This position is CHINA BASED . The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies. 
   
  The Community You Will Join:  
 Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.  
 The Community Support Products (CSP) Machine Learning team is the core team responsible for driving CSxAI (Customer Support x Artificial Intelligence) initiatives by adopting the Generative AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional service experience. The team develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and tools including LLM fine-tuning and optimization, RAG/Search,  LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.  
 The richness of Airbnb's data, the complexity of its marketplace and the variety innate in our product mean that we need to operate at the state of the art of AI practice. We are committed to investing in long term innovation to solve the complex problems we face, and to do that we need the very best experts in ML and AI to join us. 
   
  The Difference You Will Make:  
 We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.  
 You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.  
 Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities. 
   
  A Typical Day:   
 
 
 Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems 
 
 
 Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products 
 
 
 Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).  
 
 
   
  Your Expertise:  
 
 PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience 
 2-4 years of ML engineering experience, with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.  
 Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products 
 Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus 
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product & design organizations 
  Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.  
 
   
  Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:  
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We are seeking skilled engineers to build scalable distributed systems and integrate agentic AI and conversational analytics. As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will lead the architecture, data modeling, and core infrastructure powering our next-generation AI and analytics platforms.

 Architect, develop, and deploy global-scale distributed platforms and pipelines for massive data ingestion, transformation, and analytical reporting. 
 Design and refine backend infrastructure supporting Agentic AI workflows, autonomous systems, and conversational analytics with natural language interfaces. 
 Partner with application teams to define data strategies and durable conceptual models spanning OLTP/OLAP and generative AI architectures (e.g., RAG).

 Qualifications

description:
Flow Traders Hong Kong is looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer to lead the next-generation architecture of the market data and execution platforms that power our fully systematic trading. We don't treat market data as plumbing - for us it's a source of alpha, where feed handling, order book construction, and a deep understanding of exchange microstructure are themselves a competitive edge. We're looking for a senior individual contributor who has lived this philosophy in a proprietary or systematic trading environment and can squeeze every nanosecond out of the path from wire to strategy. 
 As a senior individual contributor, you'll be working on the Core Platform that underpins quantitative research, pricing, strategy development, and execution across hundreds of venues. You'll work in a tight, iterative loop with quants and technical traders, applying deep expertise in modern C++, OS internals, CPU and memory architecture, lock-free concurrency, and low-latency networking to push our systems toward state-of-the-art performance, robustness, and observability.

Our goal is to deliver the world's best long term OS stability commitment on PC, server and IoT hardware.

This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill combined with management experience. 
 Today, most Linux certification is poor quality. Vendors run one set of tests and then declare that 'the hardware is certified'. But Linux is not a static platform. During the lifespan of an LTS, new kernel improvements will be available to users, and they want to be sure that their hardware will work. Today's Linux certification programs do not meet the needs of its users, and we want to change that.

description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale. 
 The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. You will design and maintain test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security. You will build and evolve automated test frameworks – including stress testing, fuzzing, code coverage analysis, and regression detection – that not only must remain effective across many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance, but must be able to scale with the high demand for Ubuntu kernels (currently more than 160 under active support). 
 The successful candidate will bring strong Python skills, familiarity with Linux kernel internals, and experience building test infrastructure that scales. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability. 
  Location:  This role will be based remotely in the APAC region, except for Taipei, Taiwan, and Beijing, China, which are office-based locations. 
 What your day will look like

 Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team

 What we are looking for in you 
 
 Significant programming experience in Python 
 Experience with test frameworks such as LTP, kselftest, xfstests, stress-ng, fio, or similar 
 Experience designing and executing system-level tests: functional, stress, performance, or regression testing 
 Familiarity with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub CI, or similar)
